superseded_pre_fetch_only: 20e029d stays an aborted pre-fetch and is not corpus-forming
design_change: The >=3 real sections criterion is REMOVED. Audit rounds 1-3 demonstrated that real multi-part document structure is not recoverable in a format-independent way from the available parser representation: v2 markdown headings were format-biased toward HTML, the v3 regex prototype overcounted (WHO 1269, ISO 273), min-body reduced but did not validate (266/118 vs 5), and top-level numbering measured numbering systems rather than sections. The links endpoint returns inline hyperlinks only, no PDF outline/bookmarks and no heading metadata. This is not a relaxation to admit WHO; it removes a measurement claim the infrastructure cannot validate.
no_replacement_proxy: No substitute multi-part proxy is added. Any new structural measure would restart the same heuristic cycle.

qualification_gate_v3.document_type: report, standard, plan, specification, results report, technical guidance or manual - determined from URL, title and metadata ONLY, never from content judgement
qualification_gate_v3.excluded_types: landing pages, index pages, press releases, news, blogs, marketing, opinion, Wikipedia
qualification_gate_v3.measurement: usable-sentence count per the frozen mechanical filters; no section count of any kind

carryover: The two PASS documents selected under v2 stay selected (the rule change does not disqualify them). Previously rejected WHO documents may qualify under v3 because v3 is frozen BEFORE final corpus assembly. 20e029d, b02ecb0 and the audit rounds stay as design/measurement-error history and are not retroactively rewritten.
k_order: K=3 candidate order per domain is unchanged; re-qualification under v3 walks the same order without skipping, but a document already scraped is re-measured from its pinned raw markdown (no re-fetch needed).
sampling_unchanged: section-wise stride with the single global ratio for a ~200 sentence corpus; digest before inference; deterministic N=80 sample after the full production pipeline run.
blindness: no annotation and no silence inspection during corpus assembly.
forbidden: no document re-selection after seeing pipeline output
no per-document balancing or sentence caps
no corpus edits after the digest is pinned
no retroactive rewriting of the v2 audit history
no modifying v3 after the first v3 qualification verdict
